From the tables

Photos from the tavern’s own Google listing.

A courtyard in the old village

Voreas is a meze house on Andrea Dimitriou street in Oroklini, in the old part of the village above Larnaca bay. Behind the white front with the hand painted name lies a courtyard: white tablecloths, olive trees in tubs, stone arches and a wooden balcony. Guests on Google write about the view over the village and the sea from the terrace, about live music on Friday and Saturday evenings, and above all about the meze, which is mentioned in 181 of the 999 reviews.

Open every day: Monday to Thursday from four in the afternoon until midnight, Friday until two, Saturday until four in the morning, Sunday from noon until midnight. Guests recommend booking a table at the weekend. Eat in, take away or delivery.
